title: geometry
description:
The shape of a route, in the format chosen with the `geometry` query parameter.

* `geojson` (default): a GeoJSON `LineString` with `[longitude, latitude]` pairs, ready for Leaflet, MapLibre or Mapbox.
* `polyline6`: a string in the Google encoded polyline format with 6 decimals of precision. Decoders are available for every platform.
* `none`: `null`, for when you only need distance or bounds.

oneOf.description: Encoded polyline, precision 6. The example encodes the three points of the GeoJSON example.

coordinates.description: The points of the line as `[longitude, latitude]` pairs, following the GeoJSON order.

items.description: Longitude, then latitude, in decimal degrees.
